notifications.hint: Desktop notifications for new incoming channel messages
device.passiveHint: Read-only data, without telemetry requests. Missing readings stay unavailable.
device.staleHint: Disconnected. Device details and peer records are cached, not current. Session reception, queue and routing data are unavailable until reconnection.
device.peersHint: This is radio memory, not proof of coverage. Records may be old, relayed or from MQTT.
device.peersEmpty: No peer records available. This does not establish whether any radios are nearby.
channels.title: Channels
channels.empty: No radio channels available. Connect the radio to load its channels.
timeline.listening: Listening for new messages. The radio does not provide earlier history; messages received here are saved locally.
timeline.offline: Connect the radio to receive messages. Saved conversations remain available offline.
status.queued: Queued by radio · delivery not confirmed
status.acknowledged: Radio routing acknowledged · not a read receipt
compose.hint: Enter / Ctrl+Enter: send · Shift+Enter: new line
error.backend_unavailable: The local bridge is unavailable. Check the Meshtastic user service; reconnection is automatic.
error.radio_unavailable: No radio available. Check the configured USB or Bluetooth connection; reconnection is automatic.
error.radio_disconnected: Radio disconnected. Your draft is kept; restore the configured connection to send.
error.radio_ambiguous: Several serial devices were found. Set MESHTASTIC_PORT for the Meshtastic service to select your radio.
error.ble_unavailable: Bluetooth is unavailable. Enable the adapter and check Bluetooth access for the Meshtastic user service. USB is not used as a fallback.
error.ble_not_found: No matching Meshtastic Bluetooth radio was found. Keep it nearby with Bluetooth enabled and check MESHTASTIC_BLE_ADDRESS.
error.ble_pairing_required: Bluetooth pairing or authentication is required. Pair the radio in the system Bluetooth settings using its displayed PIN, then reconnect.
error.ble_ambiguous: Several Meshtastic Bluetooth radios were found. Set MESHTASTIC_BLE_ADDRESS in the Meshtastic service to select one.
error.transport_invalid: The connection mode is invalid. Set MESHTASTIC_TRANSPORT to usb or ble in the Meshtastic service.
error.region_unset: The radio has no region configured. Set the correct region in the official Meshtastic app before sending.
error.tx_disabled: Transmitting is disabled on the radio. Enable it in the official app before sending.
error.channel_unavailable: This channel is unavailable. Choose an enabled channel on the connected radio.
error.invalid_command: The bridge could not process this command. Check that the plugin and bridge versions match.
error.message_too_long: The message exceeds 228 UTF-8 bytes. Shorten it before sending.
error.send_failed: The radio could not queue this message. Your draft is kept.
error.ack_timeout: No routing acknowledgement arrived. Delivery is unknown; this is not a read receipt.
error.backend_busy: The radio is busy. Wait for the current operation to finish.
error.storage_error: Local history could not be saved. Check disk space and the Meshtastic service logs.
error.routing_failed: Radio routing reported a failure. The recipient has not confirmed delivery.
error.send_interrupted: The bridge disconnected while sending. Your draft is kept; check the timeline before retrying to avoid duplicates.
error.invalid_url: This is not a supported Meshtastic channel URL. Copy a full sharing link from the official app or community.
error.invalid_config: The shared configuration is invalid or unsupported. Obtain a new channel sharing link.
error.invalid_key: Enter a Base64 channel key containing 1, 16 or 32 decoded bytes. Short public keys must be 0–10; passphrases and hex are not accepted.
error.invalid_channel_name: Enter an exact channel name: 1–11 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters. Names are case-sensitive.
error.channels_full: No free secondary channel slot remains. Remove a channel in the official app before adding one.
error.channel_ambiguous: Several radio channels have this name. Give them distinct names in the official app, then preview again.
error.preview_expired: This preview expired or the radio changed. Preview the configuration again before applying.
error.confirmation_required: Changing radio channels requires explicit confirmation.
error.config_failed: Configuration could not be completed. Some settings may have changed: inspect the radio before trying again.
error.unknown: The operation could not be completed. Check the Meshtastic service logs.
settings.radioHint: Region and current radio settings are shown read-only. Configure the legal region in the official app. All channels share one modem preset and frequency slot; a matching channel name alone does not join a mesh.
settings.berlinHint: Berlin communities use MediumFast. Preview the documented public MediumFast + TEST starter profile below, or obtain a current sharing URL from the community. BerlinMesh coordination requires its matching channel key. Public/shared keys do not provide private messaging. This starter does not add an SOS channel.
settings.importHint: Paste a Base64 key or full Meshtastic URL. A key adds or updates only the named channel; other channels and radio settings stay unchanged. A full URL replaces all channels and may change modem settings. Preview first, then explicitly confirm. Publicly published keys do not provide private messaging.
settings.valuePlaceholder: Paste a Base64 key or full Meshtastic URL
settings.confirmHint: Replace ALL current radio channels with this profile and reboot the radio? Existing channel keys and modem settings may change. This cannot be undone here; keep a backup in the official app.
settings.confirmAddHint: Add channel %1? Other channels and LoRa settings stay unchanged. The radio may restart. An accepted command does not prove the settings were saved; check the radio after reconnecting.
settings.confirmUpdateHint: Update only the key for channel %1? Its other settings, other channels and LoRa settings stay unchanged. The radio may restart. An accepted command does not prove the settings were saved; check the radio after reconnecting.
settings.accepted: The configuration command was accepted. The radio may reboot and reconnect. This is not proof that settings were saved: check the connected radio and its channels before sending.
warning.replaces_channels: This profile replaces all current radio channels.
warning.region_preserved: The radio's current region will be preserved.
warning.region_unset: The radio region is unset; sending remains blocked until it is configured in the official app.
warning.uplink_enabled: At least one shown channel has MQTT uplink enabled; its messages may leave the radio mesh.
warning.downlink_enabled: At least one shown channel has MQTT downlink enabled; internet messages may enter that channel.
warning.public_key: At least one shown channel uses a public key; messages on that channel are not private.
warning.offline_preview: Offline preview only. Reconnect the radio and create a fresh preview before applying.
warning.other_channels_preserved: Only the named channel will be added or its key updated. Other channels and LoRa settings will be preserved.
warning.berlin_profile_mismatch: The current radio profile is not EU_868 / MEDIUM_FAST / default frequency slot. This key will not change that profile. Check the profile shown above against the community requirements; a matching name and key alone do not join its mesh.
warning.unknown: Review this profile in the official app before applying.
settings.ui.sharedRadio: All channels share one modem preset and frequency slot. Current settings are read-only.
settings.ui.starterHint: Public starter channels. Review the preview before replacing anything.
settings.ui.privateInput: The input is masked and cleared after successful preview. A public key does not provide privacy.
settings.ui.channelNameHint: The name must match the community channel; names are case-sensitive.
settings.ui.previewOnly: Nothing has changed. Applying this profile replaces all channels and reboots the radio.
settings.ui.previewAdd: Nothing has changed. Add channel %1 only; keep all other channels and current LoRa settings. Full intended channel list:
settings.ui.previewUpdate: Nothing has changed. Update only the key for %1; keep its other settings, all other channels and current LoRa settings. Full intended channel list:
settings.ui.reconnect: Connect the radio and create a fresh preview before applying.
device.ui.sessionHint: Reception during this connection, excluding MQTT data and the saved node list.
